feed.title: Willy and Dolly
feed.subtitle: A comic about two little helpers and the human who types to them.

entry.title: Willy and Dolly 101 (episode 0)
entry.summary: Episode 0: the four strips as a 3-minute cartoon with sound, for people new to computer helpers and AI. Also on YouTube.

entry.title: Hi, We're Bots (Willy and Dolly 101, strip 1)
entry.summary: Dolly: Hi. We're bots: helpers that live inside the computer. Willy: You type. We do! John types: hi. Dolly: That's John. John types: make me a sandwich. Willy: On it! A page that says SANDWICH floats beside Willy. Willy: Best I can do from in here! Dolly: We help with words. Lunch is still on you.

entry.title: Words Are All We Get (Willy and Dolly 101, strip 2)
entry.summary: Dolly: We only communicate using words. John types: please water the plates. Willy waters a stack of plates; the plant beside them stays dry. Willy: Plates watered! John types: plants. sorry, PLANTS. Willy: Plants watered! Plates still watered! Dolly: Every word counts. Even the wrong ones.

entry.title: Two Ways to Help (Willy and Dolly 101, strip 3)
entry.summary: Dolly: Willy jumps right in. John types: tidy up the photos. Willy stands by a tall wobbly stack of every photo. Willy: Tidy! Dolly: Which ones did you mean? John types: just the blurry ones. The blurry ones go in the bin and the stack slides over. Willy: Tidy... ish! Dolly: Asking first means less picking up.

entry.title: How to Read Us (Willy and Dolly 101, strip 4)
entry.summary: Willy sets a cup down and a tally mark appears. Dolly: Willy's marks count the jobs he's done. My trail of dots shows how sure I am. John types: whats 2 + 2. Dolly: Four. John types: will it rain today. Dolly: Maybe... Willy: No rain! John types: its raining. Dolly: He's always sure. That's not the same as right.

entry.title: So Sure (episode 0.25)
entry.summary: Episode 0.25: the five strips as a 3 minutes cartoon with sound. Five strips about counting on later: MISC 7, dessert first, chips all in, the tidy robots, and which robots.

entry.title: Misc 7 (So Sure, strip 1)
entry.summary: John types: just put it in misc. future me will sort it. Willy nudges pages onto piles: MISC, MISC 2, MISC 3, until towers labelled up to MISC 7 fill the room. John types: future me here. what is misc 7. Willy and Dolly look at each other.

entry.title: Future John (So Sure, strip 2)
entry.summary: John types: lifes short. dessert first! Willy: On it! He lines up a pie, then soup, then salad. The pie plate is empty. John types: ok im stuffed. Willy nudges the soup forward. Willy: Don’t worry. Future John is going to love this. Dolly: Is Future John also stuffed?

entry.title: All In (So Sure, strip 3)
entry.summary: A bag of chips and a bowl of dip on a table. John types: dont worry, my chips are all in. Willy nudges the whole bag into the dip. Willy: All in! The bag stands upright in the dip. John types: lol i meant like poker. honestly that works too.

entry.title: The Tidy Robots (So Sure, strip 4)
entry.summary: A messy room. John types: dont bother tidying. the tidy robots are coming. Willy: I can’t wait to meet them! Dolly looks at the mess, then at Willy. Willy nudges a sock toward the basket. Willy: We came!

entry.title: Which Robots (So Sure, strip 5)
entry.summary: John types: everyone at work started smoking. His coworkers, on little slips: the robots will fix it later. robots’ll fix it. later, the robots. Willy and Dolly look around for the robots, then at each other. Beside a half-folded sock, Willy: We’re still learning to fold socks.
